## Loading of the libraries

We are using tidyverse framework to rearrange and analysis the data. 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

library(readxl) # read excel files
library("openxlsx")   #The openxlsx package is highly customizable and allows you to: Write multiple data frames to different sheets of the same Excel file. Customize formatting, such as column widths, bold headers, and colors.
```


## Load all the sheets of the the component family composotion (% total weigt & % material composition)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

vehicleWeight <- read_excel(filename2_input, sheet = "totalWeight")
productKeys <- read_excel(filename2_input, sheet = "ProductKeys")

vPetrol_componentfamiliy_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vPertol")
vDiesel_componentfamiliy_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vDiesel")
vBEV_componentfamiliy_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vBEV")
vHEV_componentfamiliy_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vHEV")
vPHEV_componentfamiliy_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vPHEV")
vOther_componentfamiliy_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vOther")

vPetrol_Powertrain_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vPetrolPowertrain")
vDiesel_Powertrain_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vDieselPowertrain")
vBEV_Powertrain_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vBEVPowertrain")
vHEV_Powertrain_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vHEVPowertrain")
vPHEV_Powertrain_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vPHEVPowertrain")
vOther_Powertrain_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vOtherPowertrain")

vGeneratorRatio <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vGenerator")    # HEV & PHEV

vBEV_Electronics_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vBEVElectronic")
vHEV_Electronics_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vHEVElectronic")
vPHEV_Electronics_composition <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vPHEVElectronic")

vBattery <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vBattery")

vFuelcell <- read_excel(filename5_input, sheet = "vFuelcell")
```

## Calculate the mass and material composition of a pertrol car powertrain

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

vPowertrain <- vPetrol_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vPowertrain))
vPetrol_Powertrain <- left_join(vPetrol_Powertrain_composition, vPowertrain, by = "productKeyLevel2")
vPetrol_Powertrain_ratio <- vPetrol_Powertrain %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vPowertrain)) %>% select(-vPowertrain)

# Add the segment column and get ride of productKeyLevel1 and productKeyLevel2 - It allows to add the dataset to the calculate dataset
vPetrol_Powertrain_ratio <- vPetrol_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vPetrol_Powertrain_ratio, by = "segment")

# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  castingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), castingAlCalculate - (castingAl * castingAlCalculate), castingAlCalculate),
                  extrusionAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), extrusionAlCalculate - (extrusionAl * extrusionAlCalculate), extrusionAlCalculate),
                  forgingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), forgingAlCalculate - (forgingAl * forgingAlCalculate), forgingAlCalculate),
                  sheetAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), sheetAlCalculate - (sheetAl * sheetAlCalculate), sheetAlCalculate),
                  totalAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), castingAlCalculate + extrusionAlCalculate + forgingAlCalculate + sheetAlCalculate, totalAlCalculate),
                  castIronCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), castIronCalculate - (castIron * castIronCalculate), castIronCalculate),
                  mildSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), mildSteelCalculate - (mildSteel * mildSteelCalculate), mildSteelCalculate),
                  HSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), HSSCalculate - (HSS * HSSCalculate), HSSCalculate),
                  AHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), AHSSCalculate - (AHSS * AHSSCalculate), AHSSCalculate),
                  UHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), UHSSCalculate - (UHSS * UHSSCalculate), UHSSCalculate),
                  totalIronSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), castIronCalculate + mildSteelCalculate + HSSCalculate + AHSSCalculate + UHSSCalculate, totalIronSteelCalculate),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV", "elvHEV", "elvPHEV", "elvOther"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(castingAl, extrusionAl, forgingAl, sheetAl, castIron, mildSteel, HSS, AHSS, UHSS, Total))
#calculate

```

### BEV

## Calcualate the mass and material composition of a BEV powertrain, electronics & dummy battery

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#
# Powertrain  --------
vPowertrain <- vBEV_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vPowertrain))
vBEV_Powertrain <- left_join(vBEV_Powertrain_composition, vPowertrain, by = "productKeyLevel2") %>% select(-Total)
vBEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vBEV_Powertrain %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vPowertrain)) %>% select(-vPowertrain)

# Add the segment column and get ride of productKeyLevel1 and productKeyLevel2 - It allows to add the dataset to the calculate dataset
vBEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vBEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

## Calculate the weight of the cooper cables in the electric motors and the weight of the permanent magnets
vBEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vBEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(vehicleWeight %>% select(segment, elvBEV), by = "segment" )
vBEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vBEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% mutate(engineCableBEV = engineCableBEV * elvBEV, perMagnetBEV = perMagnetBEV * elvBEV) %>% select(-c(elvBEV))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vBEV_Powertrain_ratio, by = "segment")

# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  castingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), castingAlCalculate - (castingAl * castingAlCalculate), castingAlCalculate),
                  extrusionAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), extrusionAlCalculate - (extrusionAl * extrusionAlCalculate), extrusionAlCalculate),
                  forgingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), forgingAlCalculate - (forgingAl * forgingAlCalculate), forgingAlCalculate),
                  sheetAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), sheetAlCalculate - (sheetAl * sheetAlCalculate), sheetAlCalculate),
                  totalAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), castingAlCalculate + extrusionAlCalculate + forgingAlCalculate + sheetAlCalculate, totalAlCalculate),
                  castIronCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), castIronCalculate - (castIron * castIronCalculate), castIronCalculate),
                  mildSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), mildSteelCalculate - (mildSteel * mildSteelCalculate), mildSteelCalculate),
                  HSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), HSSCalculate - (HSS * HSSCalculate), HSSCalculate),
                  AHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), AHSSCalculate - (AHSS * AHSSCalculate), AHSSCalculate),
                  UHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), UHSSCalculate - (UHSS * UHSSCalculate), UHSSCalculate),
                  totalIronSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), castIronCalculate + mildSteelCalculate + HSSCalculate + AHSSCalculate + UHSSCalculate, totalIronSteelCalculate),
                  engineCable = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), engineCableBEV, 0),
                  perMagnet = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), perMagnetBEV, 0),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total + engineCable + perMagnet, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(castingAl, extrusionAl, forgingAl, sheetAl, castIron, mildSteel, HSS, AHSS, UHSS, engineCableBEV, perMagnetBEV))
#calculate

#
# Electronics ------
vElectronics <- vBEV_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vElectronics))
vBEV_Electronics <- inner_join(vBEV_Electronics_composition, vElectronics, by = "productKeyLevel2")
vBEV_Electronics_ratio <- vBEV_Electronics %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vElectronics)) %>% select(-vElectronics)

# Add the segment column and get ride of productKeyLevel1 and productKeyLevel2 - It allows to add the dataset to the calculate dataset
vBEV_Electronics_ratio <- vBEV_Electronics_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vBEV_Electronics_ratio, by = "segment")

# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  actuators = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), actuators - (actuatorUpdate * actuators), actuators),
                  controllers = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), controllers - (controllerUpdate * controllers), controllers),
                  light = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), light - (lightUpdate * light), light),
                  cableLike = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), cableLike - (cableLikeUpdate * cableLike), cableLike),
                  powerElectronics = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), powerElectronics - (powerElectronicUpdate * powerElectronics), powerElectronics),
                  EED_total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), actuators + controllers + light + cableLike + powerElectronics, EED_total),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(actuatorUpdate, controllerUpdate, lightUpdate, cableLikeUpdate, powerElectronicUpdate))
#calculate

#
# Battery dummy weight

# join battery weight
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vBattery, by = "segment")

calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  battery = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), vBatteryBEV, 0),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvBEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas + battery, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(vBatteryBEV, vBatteryHEV, vBatteryPHEV, vBatteryOther))
#calculate
```

## HEV (V040101XXXX)

## Calcualate the mass and material composition of a HEV powertrain, electronics & dummy battery

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#
# Powertrain  --------
vPowertrain <- vHEV_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vPowertrain))
vHEV_Powertrain <- left_join(vHEV_Powertrain_composition, vPowertrain, by = "productKeyLevel2") %>% select(-Total)
vHEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vHEV_Powertrain %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vPowertrain)) %>% select(-vPowertrain)

# Add the segment column and get ride of productKeyLevel1 and productKeyLevel2 - It allows to add the dataset to the calculate dataset
vHEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vHEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

# Split the permanent magnets and cooper to the electric engine and the altenator (generator), which also starts the petrol engine
generatorRatio <- vGeneratorRatio %>% filter(drivetrain == "HEV")

## Calculate the weight of the cooper cables in the electric motors and the weight of the permanent magnets
vHEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vHEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(vehicleWeight %>% select(segment, elvHEV), by = "segment" )
vHEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vHEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% mutate(engineCableHEV = engineCableHEV * elvHEV * (1 - generatorRatio$ratio),
                                                          perMagnetHEV = perMagnetHEV * elvHEV * (1 - generatorRatio$ratio),
                                                          generatorCableHEV = engineCableHEV / (1 - generatorRatio$ratio) * generatorRatio$ratio,
                                                          generatorPerMagnetHEV = perMagnetHEV / (1 - generatorRatio$ratio) * generatorRatio$ratio) %>% select(-c(elvHEV))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vHEV_Powertrain_ratio, by = "segment")

calculate <- calculate %>% mutate(
    generatorCable = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 == "elvHEV" | productKeyLevel1 == "elvPHEV", 1, 0),
    generatorperMagnet = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 == "elvHEV" | productKeyLevel1 == "elvPHEV", 1, 0)
  )


# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  castingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), castingAlCalculate - (castingAl * castingAlCalculate), castingAlCalculate),
                  extrusionAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), extrusionAlCalculate - (extrusionAl * extrusionAlCalculate), extrusionAlCalculate),
                  forgingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), forgingAlCalculate - (forgingAl * forgingAlCalculate), forgingAlCalculate),
                  sheetAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), sheetAlCalculate - (sheetAl * sheetAlCalculate), sheetAlCalculate),
                  totalAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), castingAlCalculate + extrusionAlCalculate + forgingAlCalculate + sheetAlCalculate, totalAlCalculate),
                  castIronCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), castIronCalculate - (castIron * castIronCalculate), castIronCalculate),
                  mildSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), mildSteelCalculate - (mildSteel * mildSteelCalculate), mildSteelCalculate),
                  HSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), HSSCalculate - (HSS * HSSCalculate), HSSCalculate),
                  AHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), AHSSCalculate - (AHSS * AHSSCalculate), AHSSCalculate),
                  UHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), UHSSCalculate - (UHSS * UHSSCalculate), UHSSCalculate),
                  totalIronSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), castIronCalculate + mildSteelCalculate + HSSCalculate + AHSSCalculate + UHSSCalculate, totalIronSteelCalculate),
                  engineCable = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), engineCableHEV, ifelse(engineCable > 0, engineCable, 0)),
                  perMagnet = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), perMagnetHEV,  ifelse(perMagnet > 0, perMagnet, 0)),
                  generatorCable = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), generatorCableHEV, ifelse(generatorCable > 0, generatorCable, 0)),
                  generatorperMagnet = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), generatorPerMagnetHEV,  ifelse(generatorperMagnet > 0, generatorperMagnet, 0)),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total + engineCable + perMagnet + generatorCable + generatorperMagnet, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(castingAl, extrusionAl, forgingAl, sheetAl, castIron, mildSteel, HSS, AHSS, UHSS, engineCableHEV, perMagnetHEV, generatorCableHEV, generatorPerMagnetHEV))
#calculate

#
# Electronics ------
vElectronics <- vHEV_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vElectronics))
vHEV_Electronics <- inner_join(vHEV_Electronics_composition, vElectronics, by = "productKeyLevel2")
vHEV_Electronics_ratio <- vHEV_Electronics %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vElectronics)) %>% select(-vElectronics)

# Add the segment column and get ride of productKeyLevel1 and productKeyLevel2 - It allows to add the dataset to the calculate dataset
vHEV_Electronics_ratio <- vHEV_Electronics_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vHEV_Electronics_ratio, by = "segment")

# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  actuators = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), actuators - (actuatorUpdate * actuators), actuators),
                  controllers = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), controllers - (controllerUpdate * controllers), controllers),
                  light = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), light - (lightUpdate * light), light),
                  cableLike = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), cableLike - (cableLikeUpdate * cableLike), cableLike),
                  powerElectronics = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), powerElectronics - (powerElectronicUpdate * powerElectronics), powerElectronics),
                  EED_total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), actuators + controllers + light + cableLike + powerElectronics, EED_total),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total + engineCable + perMagnet + generatorCable + generatorperMagnet, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(actuatorUpdate, controllerUpdate, lightUpdate, cableLikeUpdate, powerElectronicUpdate))
#calculate

#
# Battery dummy weight

# join battery weight
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vBattery, by = "segment")

calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  battery = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), vBatteryHEV, ifelse(battery > 0, battery, 0)),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvHEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas + battery, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(vBatteryBEV, vBatteryHEV, vBatteryPHEV, vBatteryOther))
calculate
```


## PHEV (V050103XXXX)

## Calcualate the mass and material composition of a HEV powertrain, electronics & dummy battery

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#
# Powertrain  --------
vPowertrain <- vPHEV_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vPowertrain))
vPHEV_Powertrain <- left_join(vPHEV_Powertrain_composition, vPowertrain, by = "productKeyLevel2") %>% select(-Total)

vPHEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vPHEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

# Split the permanent magnets and cooper to the electric engine and the altenator (generator), which also starts the petrol engine
generatorRatio <- vGeneratorRatio %>% filter(drivetrain == "PHEV")

## Calculate the weight of the cooper cables in the electric motors and the weight of the permanent magnets
vPHEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vPHEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(vehicleWeight %>% select(segment, elvPHEV), by = "segment" )
vPHEV_Powertrain_ratio <- vPHEV_Powertrain_ratio %>% mutate(engineCablePHEV = engineCablePHEV * elvPHEV * (1 - generatorRatio$ratio),

                                                          generatorPerMagnetPHEV = perMagnetPHEV / (1 - generatorRatio$ratio) * generatorRatio$ratio) %>% select(-c(elvPHEV))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vPHEV_Powertrain_ratio, by = "segment")

# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  castingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), castingAlCalculate - (castingAl * castingAlCalculate), castingAlCalculate),
                  extrusionAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), extrusionAlCalculate - (extrusionAl * extrusionAlCalculate), extrusionAlCalculate),
                  forgingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), forgingAlCalculate - (forgingAl * forgingAlCalculate), forgingAlCalculate),
                  sheetAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), sheetAlCalculate - (sheetAl * sheetAlCalculate), sheetAlCalculate),
                  totalAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), castingAlCalculate + extrusionAlCalculate + forgingAlCalculate + sheetAlCalculate, totalAlCalculate),
                  castIronCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), castIronCalculate - (castIron * castIronCalculate), castIronCalculate),
                  mildSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), mildSteelCalculate - (mildSteel * mildSteelCalculate), mildSteelCalculate),

                  UHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), UHSSCalculate - (UHSS * UHSSCalculate), UHSSCalculate),
                  totalIronSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), castIronCalculate + mildSteelCalculate + HSSCalculate + AHSSCalculate + UHSSCalculate, totalIronSteelCalculate),
                  engineCable = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), engineCablePHEV, ifelse(engineCable > 0, engineCable, 0)),
                  perMagnet = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), perMagnetPHEV,  ifelse(perMagnet > 0, perMagnet, 0)),
                  generatorCable = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), generatorCablePHEV, ifelse(generatorCable > 0, generatorCable, 0)),
                  generatorperMagnet = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), generatorPerMagnetPHEV,  ifelse(generatorperMagnet > 0, generatorperMagnet, 0)),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total + engineCable + perMagnet + generatorCable + generatorperMagnet, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(castingAl, extrusionAl, forgingAl, sheetAl, castIron, mildSteel, HSS, AHSS, UHSS, engineCablePHEV, perMagnetPHEV, generatorCablePHEV, generatorPerMagnetPHEV))
#calculate

#
# Electronics ------
vElectronics <- vPHEV_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vElectronics))
vPHEV_Electronics <- inner_join(vPHEV_Electronics_composition, vElectronics, by = "productKeyLevel2")
vPHEV_Electronics_ratio <- vPHEV_Electronics %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vElectronics)) %>% select(-vElectronics)

# Add the segment column and get ride of productKeyLevel1 and productKeyLevel2 - It allows to add the dataset to the calculate dataset
vPHEV_Electronics_ratio <- vPHEV_Electronics_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vPHEV_Electronics_ratio, by = "segment")

# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  actuators = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), actuators - (actuatorUpdate * actuators), actuators),
                  controllers = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), controllers - (controllerUpdate * controllers), controllers),
                  light = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), light - (lightUpdate * light), light),
                  cableLike = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), cableLike - (cableLikeUpdate * cableLike), cableLike),
                  powerElectronics = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), powerElectronics - (powerElectronicUpdate * powerElectronics), powerElectronics),
                  EED_total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), actuators + controllers + light + cableLike + powerElectronics, EED_total),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total + engineCable + perMagnet + generatorCable + generatorperMagnet, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(actuatorUpdate, controllerUpdate, lightUpdate, cableLikeUpdate, powerElectronicUpdate))
#calculate

#
# Battery dummy weight

# join battery weight
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vBattery, by = "segment")

calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  battery = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), vBatteryPHEV, ifelse(battery > 0, battery, 0)),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvPHEV"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas + battery, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(vBatteryBEV, vBatteryHEV, vBatteryPHEV, vBatteryOther))
calculate
```

## Other (V060104XXXX)

## Calcualate the mass and material composition of an Other powertrain, electronics & dummy battery

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#
# Powertrain  --------
vPowertrain <- vOther_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vPowertrain))
vOther_Powertrain <- left_join(vOther_Powertrain_composition, vPowertrain, by = "productKeyLevel2") %>% select(-Total)
vOther_Powertrain_ratio <- vOther_Powertrain %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vPowertrain)) %>% select(-vPowertrain)

# Add the segment column and get ride of productKeyLevel1 and productKeyLevel2 - It allows to add the dataset to the calculate dataset
vOther_Powertrain_ratio <- vOther_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(productKeys, by = "productKeyLevel2" ) %>% select(-c(productKeyLevel1, productKeyLevel2))

## Calculate the weight of the cooper cables in the electric motors and the weight of the permanent magnets
vOther_Powertrain_ratio <- vOther_Powertrain_ratio %>% left_join(vehicleWeight %>% select(segment, elvOther), by = "segment" )
vOther_Powertrain_ratio <- vOther_Powertrain_ratio %>% mutate(engineCableOther = engineCableOther * elvOther, perMagnetOther = perMagnetOther * elvOther) %>% select(-c(elvOther))

# Prepare for the calculations by adding the powertrain ratios using the segments as key
calculate <- calculate %>% left_join(vOther_Powertrain_ratio, by = "segment")

# Performing the calculation for the BEV, HEV, PHEV and Other
calculate <- calculate %>%
                mutate(
                  castingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), castingAlCalculate - (castingAl * castingAlCalculate), castingAlCalculate),
                  extrusionAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), extrusionAlCalculate - (extrusionAl * extrusionAlCalculate), extrusionAlCalculate),
                  forgingAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), forgingAlCalculate - (forgingAl * forgingAlCalculate), forgingAlCalculate),
                  sheetAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), sheetAlCalculate - (sheetAl * sheetAlCalculate), sheetAlCalculate),
                  totalAlCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), castingAlCalculate + extrusionAlCalculate + forgingAlCalculate + sheetAlCalculate, totalAlCalculate),
                  castIronCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), castIronCalculate - (castIron * castIronCalculate), castIronCalculate),
                  mildSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), mildSteelCalculate - (mildSteel * mildSteelCalculate), mildSteelCalculate),
                  HSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), HSSCalculate - (HSS * HSSCalculate), HSSCalculate),
                  AHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), AHSSCalculate - (AHSS * AHSSCalculate), AHSSCalculate),
                  UHSSCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), UHSSCalculate - (UHSS * UHSSCalculate), UHSSCalculate),
                  totalIronSteelCalculate = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), castIronCalculate + mildSteelCalculate + HSSCalculate + AHSSCalculate + UHSSCalculate, totalIronSteelCalculate),
                  engineCable = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), engineCableOther, ifelse(engineCable > 0, engineCable, 0)),
                  perMagnet = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), perMagnetOther,  ifelse(perMagnet > 0, perMagnet, 0)),
                  totalMetals = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), totalAlCalculate + totalIronSteelCalculate + EED_total + engineCable + perMagnet, totalMetals),
                  total = ifelse(productKeyLevel1 %in% c("elvOther"), totalMetals + totalOtherMaterilas, total)
                )

# Remove the additional columns
calculate <- calculate %>% select(-c(castingAl, extrusionAl, forgingAl, sheetAl, castIron, mildSteel, HSS, AHSS, UHSS, engineCableOther, perMagnetOther))
#calculate

# Electronics ------
vElectronics <- vOther_componentfamiliy_composition %>% select(c(productKeyLevel2, vElectronics))
vOther_Electronics <- inner_join(vOther_Electronics_composition, vElectronics, by = "productKeyLevel2")
vOther_Electronics_ratio <- vOther_Electronics %>% mutate(across(-productKeyLevel2, ~ . *  vElectronics)) %>% select(-vElectronics)
```
